definitions.explanation: The maintenance and promotion of health. Commonly used in compound words related to public health services, school health programs, and healthcare systems.

examples.japanese: {保健|ほけん}の{授業|じゅぎょう}がある。
{保健室|ほけんしつ}で{休|やす}ませてもらった。
examples.english: I was allowed to rest in the school nurse's office.

examples.japanese: {世界|せかい}{保健|ほけん}{機関|きかん}が{新|あたら}しいガイドラインを{発表|はっぴょう}した。
examples.english: The World Health Organization released new guidelines.

notes:
Not to be confused with the homophone {保険|ほけん} (insurance). {保健|ほけん} relates to health maintenance and public health, while {保険|ほけん} relates to financial insurance.

Very common in compound words related to schools and public institutions.

COMPOUNDS:
- {保健室|ほけんしつ} — school nurse's office
- {保健所|ほけんじょ} — public health center
- {保健師|ほけんし} — public health nurse
- {保健|ほけん}{体育|たいいく} — health and physical education
